## Extension authors

The {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode_shortname %} extension API hides most of the implementation details of running remotely so many extensions will just work in GitHub Codespaces environments without any modification. However, we recommend that you test your extension in a codespace to be sure that all of its functionality works as expected. See the article on [Supporting Remote Development and GitHub Codespaces](/api/advanced-topics/remote-extensions.md) for details.
